# Human-readable GitHub Release lead for v0.8.1

> Prepared copy only. Editing the live GitHub Release remains an owner-authorized external action.

## Suggested lead

Scope, audit, harden, and retest web projects with AI coding agents and reproducible evidence.

Web App Security Skill gives Web builders using AI coding agents a reviewable local security first pass. Run it without installing:

```bash
npx --yes web-app-security-skill@0.8.1 audit . --fail-on never
```

The report explains each lead in security terms and ordinary language, states what the evidence
does not prove, proposes a change for review, names likely product side effects, and separates
security retesting from normal-behavior testing. The command does not edit the project or contact
a deployment.

Release v0.8.1 includes route-security v3 for bounded Express, NestJS and
Next.js App Router routes plus Server Actions. For exact supported shapes, it follows a
request-selected object identifier through at most four exact project-local calls into supported
Prisma or Drizzle operations, while keeping object, principal and tenant facts separate. Visible
query constraints, post-load comparisons, external-policy dependencies and incomplete paths
remain distinct outcomes. A completed static path does not prove deployed enforcement, correct
authorization or a vulnerability, and the fixed-corpus result is not production precision/recall.

## Keep below this lead

Retain the existing signed-tag, asset digest, SBOM, manifest, provenance, immutable Action and
verified-installer evidence below the human-readable opening.
